paragraphs.text: The very next day after the priest’s consecration, that no time might be lost. "I made haste and delayed not," &c. {Psa 119:16} "Then said I, Lo I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me," &c. {Psa 40:7} Live, live, live, saith one, quickly, much, long: let no water go by, no day be lost, &c. Preach, preach, be instant, quick at work, &c.
“ Praecipitat tempus, mors atra impendet agenti. ”
In remembrance, and for the remission of Aaron’s sin about the golden calf; as some Hebrews are of opinion.
Quia gravis odor peccati. The smell of sin is grievous; it offendeth all God’s senses, yea, his very soul. {Isa 1:12-13, &c.}
paragraphs.anchor: Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering.

paragraphs.text: And he may not find you empty handed, unprepared. {See Trapp on "Exo 19:10"}
paragraphs.anchor: For today the Lord will appear unto you.

paragraphs.text: So shall it one day to us: yea, we shall be like him, and appear with him in glory; and must therefore purify ourselves, as God is pure. {1Jn 3:2-3}
paragraphs.anchor: And the glory of the Lord shall appear unto you.

paragraphs.text: See Heb 5:3; Heb 7:27-28. {See Trapp on "Heb 5:3"} {See Trapp on "Heb 7:27"} {See Trapp on "Heb 7:28"}

i.e., The brazen altar; for he had not yet access to the altar of incense. We must slay our corruptions before we present our supplications, wash our hearts from wickedness, and then compass God’s altar.
He put the blessing upon them. A type of Christ. {Luk 24:50 Act 3:26 Eph 1:3}
The consideration of God’s gracious acceptation of us in Christ should make us to lift many a humble, joyful, and thankful heart to God.
paragraphs.anchor: They shouted, and fell on their faces.
